title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Lemon & Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Lemon & Lime Nic Salt e-liquid offers a vibrant citrus blend that perfectly balances the zesty, tangy flavours of fresh Lemons and Limes. This e-liquid provides a sharp, refreshing vape that’s packed with bold, citrusy goodness. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are ideal for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and pod systems, delivering smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief. Available in both 10mg and 20mg strengths, this e-liquid offers a crisp and refreshing vaping experience. Pukka Juice’s award-winning range of e-liquids includes the 5000+ series, which brings intense disposable-style flavours to a more versatile format. Explore other Pukka Juice 5000+ flavours such as Blue Sour Razz, Polar Mint, and Berry Frenzy.
